meta.change_basis: CAD rev E review, 2026-11-10. Four inputs changed from v0.1: thermal.c_plate_j_k, thermal.r_plate_wall_k_w, thermal.r_node_plate_k_w, solar.clear_peak_w_m2 (with scenario g_peak). pv.tilt_deg and pv.azimuth are new descriptive entries. Every other value is carried from v0.1 unchanged.

grades.SOURCE: Directly stated in a source document (design docs, read 2026-11-11; CAD rev E geometry, 2026-11-10)
grades.ESTIMATE: Planning value or engineering approximation (not a verified measurement)
grades.ASSUMPTION: Introduced for this simulation; not present in any source document
grades.MEASURED: Observed from real hardware (NONE in v0.2: the build log contains zero recorded measurements as of 2026-11-11)

sources.core_thesis: Thelvanor Core Thesis: 100 W panel + 12 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 (256 Wh); nothing VERIFIED as of 2026-10-15; BOM $830 + $170 contingency.
sources.concept_note: TXST EMGT PhD Concept Note: 256 Wh carries three idle Pi 5 nodes through a 14-h winter night with ~26 Wh to spare; paired static-quota vs SoC-price scheduler trials; admission invariant 'stored energy never crosses the reserve'.
sources.blueprint_pdf: Keg-1 Solar Cluster Blueprint: 5-gal 304 SS ball-lock keg; thermal path chip->pad->plate->pad->wall->outside air, no fans; bucks 12->5.1 V 5 A; 'PLANNING ESTIMATES - NOT MEASUREMENTS: 12.8 W idle | 26.1 W full | 256 Wh nominal'; power plant OUTSIDE keg.
sources.assembly_pdf: Keg-1 Assembly Instructions: RPi 5 throttles ~80 C, harder at 85 C (Raspberry Pi documentation); main fuse <=7 in from battery+.
sources.build_log: Keg-1 Build Log: ZERO recorded measurements as of 2026-11-11. Claims c01-c10 open.
sources.cad_rev_e: Keg-1 Solar Cluster CAD rev E (engineering review only, not released for fabrication): rolled 3 mm aluminium strip R102/R105, 66 mm developed x 375 mm; strip mass 0.200 kg; wall-side pad area 25,348 mm^2 (0.534 of rev D); solid aluminium SoC spacer 13.262 mm; second pad 0.5-1.638 mm; PV fixed at 30 deg tilt facing south. Purchased-part dimensions unverified.

meta.internal_units: SI: watts (W), joules (J), seconds (s), Celsius for temperatures (identical to K for deltas). Telemetry exports Wh and degC.

pv.rated_power_w.basis: Core Thesis + Blueprint + BOM: 100 W 12 V mono PV panel. Real harvest derate 0.6-0.8 per build-log claim c10 (open expectation).

pv.tilt_deg.basis: NEW in v0.2. CAD rev E owner default: fixed 30 deg tilt. Descriptive; its effect enters through solar.clear_peak_w_m2.

pv.azimuth.basis: NEW in v0.2. CAD rev E owner default: panel faces south.

mppt.efficiency.basis: MPPT 10-20 A LiFePO4-profile class (Blueprint). Efficiency not stated in sources.

battery.capacity_wh.basis: Core Thesis / Blueprint / BOM: 12.8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 = 256 Wh nominal. Blueprint labels it a planning estimate, not a measurement.

battery.nominal_v.basis: 12.8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 with BMS (Blueprint); resting 13.0-13.4 V (Assembly).

battery.eta_charge.basis: LiFePO4 charge efficiency class; not in sources.

battery.eta_discharge.basis: LiFePO4 discharge efficiency class; not in sources.

battery.soc_min_bms.basis: Typical BMS low-voltage cutoff floor for LiFePO4; cutoff value not stated in sources.

reserve.fraction.basis: Protected energy reserve policy; Concept Note requires the invariant 'stored energy never crosses the reserve' but does not fix the fraction. 20% of nominal chosen as default.

buck.efficiency.basis: Bucks 12->5.1 V 5 A per Blueprint (SOURCE topology); efficiency not stated.

bus.topology.value: PV -> MPPT -> LiFePO4 battery -> protected fused DC bus -> buck converters -> 3x Raspberry Pi 5 + 5-port GbE switch
bus.topology.basis: Blueprint power chain; power plant mounted OUTSIDE the keg.

node.count.basis: 3x Raspberry Pi 5 1 GB (Blueprint, BOM, Core Thesis).

node.p_idle_w.basis: Partition of 12.8 W system idle planning value (3 x 3.333 + switch 2.0 + sensors 0.8). Build-log claim c04 expects 2.5-3.5 W idle per node (open, unmeasured).

node.p_full_w.basis: Partition of 26.1 W system full-load planning value. Claim c04 expects 6-8 W full per node; c05 expects ~26 W +/-20% at bus (open, unmeasured).

system.p_idle_w.basis: Blueprint: 'PLANNING ESTIMATES - NOT MEASUREMENTS: 12.8 W idle'.

system.p_full_w.basis: Blueprint: 'PLANNING ESTIMATES - NOT MEASUREMENTS: 26.1 W full'.

switch.p_w.basis: 5-port GbE switch (SOURCE topology); power draw is a small-switch class estimate.

sensors.p_w.basis: Sensor suite is SOURCE (2x INA226, 4x DS18B20, 1x BME280 + MCU); power draw allowance is assumed.

thermal.c_node_j_k.basis: RPi5 PCB + SoC effective heat capacity. Needs identification from heating/cooling tests (claim c08 procedure).

thermal.r_node_plate_k_w.basis: CHANGED in v0.2 (was 2.5). Rev E stack over a 20 x 20 mm footprint, 1-D conduction R = t/(k A): 1.5 mm SoC pad (1.25 K/W) + 13.262 mm aluminium spacer at 167 W/mK (0.20 K/W) + curved second pad, mean 1.34 mm (1.12 K/W) = 2.57 K/W. Pad conductivity 3 W/mK is assumed (the v0.1 value implied the same). Contact and spreading resistance are not included, so the real value is likely higher.

thermal.c_plate_j_k.basis: CHANGED in v0.2 (was 340). Rev E narrow strip 3 x 66 x 375 mm = 74,250 mm^3 = 0.200 kg, plus three solid spacers 20 x 20 x 13.262 mm = 0.043 kg; 0.243 kg x 900 J/kgK = 219 J/K. Alloy assumed.

thermal.r_plate_wall_k_w.basis: CHANGED in v0.2 (was 0.3). The v0.1 value was assumed for the wide plate. Interface resistance scales inversely with contact area; rev E wall-side pad area is 0.534 of rev D, so 0.3 / 0.534 = 0.56 K/W. Still an assumed base value.

thermal.c_wall_j_k.basis: ~4 kg class empty 5-gal 304 SS keg, cp~500 J/kgK. Unchanged. CAD rev E computes 7.0 kg for a 2 mm wall, which is itself unverified; weigh the keg.

thermal.r_wall_amb_k_w.basis: Natural convection + radiation from ~0.5 m^2 keg outer area, h~4-7 W/m^2K. Unchanged. Treats the whole wall as one temperature; with the narrower rev E strip the heat enters a smaller patch, so this is optimistic by an unknown amount.

thermal.throttle_c.basis: Assembly doc: RPi 5 throttles ~80 C (Raspberry Pi documentation). Sim uses 80 C as the protection policy limit.

thermal.throttle_ref_c.basis: Assembly doc: harder throttling at 85 C. Reference only; sim policy uses 80 C.

site.lat_deg.basis: San Marcos, TX inferred from Concept Note context; deployment site not confirmed in sources.

site.tz_offset_h.basis: US Central Standard Time for winter scenarios.

solar.clear_peak_w_m2.basis: CHANGED in v0.2 (was 620, a horizontal-panel value). Clear-sky plane-of-array peak for a south-facing 30 deg tilt at 29.88 N on the winter solstice: noon sun elevation 36.7 deg; direct beam from an air-mass model (1353 x 0.7^(AM^0.678)) plus 10% isotropic diffuse gives 833 W/m^2 on the tilted panel against 569 W/m^2 horizontal. No site irradiance data in sources. The scenarios read this value as G_PEAK_WINTER_W_M2.

solar.harvest_wh_per_psh.basis: Build-log claim c10 expectation '~70 Wh per PSH; derate 0.6-0.8' (open, unmeasured). Cross-check for the weather model, not a forcing input.

expectation.night_margin_wh.basis: Concept Note / claim c06: 256 Wh should carry three idle nodes through a 14-h winter night with ~26 Wh to spare (planning estimate, unmeasured). The twin must reproduce or refute this from the model; it is never hard-coded.

scheduler.static.quota_wh_per_day.basis: Fixed daily compute-energy quota for the static scheduler.

scheduler.static.util_cap.basis: Fixed utilization cap for static quota scheduler.

scheduler.socaware.safety_factor.basis: Admission safety multiplier on predicted overnight need.

integration.dt_s.basis: Default integration step; equals telemetry interval.

work.job_class.value: batch inference jobs, 300-3600 node-seconds at u=1
work.job_class.basis: Synthetic workload; replaceable by measured job profiles.
